test_cases.title: Check Product Name Display
steps: Navigate to the Product Detail Page (PDP).
Verify that the product name is displayed prominently in an H1 tag.
test_cases.expected_result: The full and clear product name is visible in H1 format at the top of the page.

test_cases.title: Verify Image Gallery Functionality
steps: Hover over the main product image to check for zoom functionality.
Click on the main image to open the lightbox gallery.
Navigate through the thumbnails in the lightbox.
test_cases.expected_result: Zoom functionality works on hover. The lightbox opens and displays all images with navigation available.

test_cases.title: Ensure Correct Display of Price with Discount
steps: Load a product page with a discounted price.
Verify that the current price is displayed prominently.
Check that the original price shows as crossed out and that the discount percentage is visible.
test_cases.expected_result: The current price is highlighted, the original price is struck through, and the discount percentage is displayed correctly.

test_cases.title: Validate Required Options are Selected
steps: Navigate to the product page with required options (size, color).
Ensure the 'Add to Cart' button is disabled when no options are selected.
Select a required option and check if the button becomes enabled.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Add to Cart' button is initially disabled and becomes enabled after selecting all required options.

test_cases.title: Test Out of Stock Messaging
steps: Navigate to a product that is out of stock.
View the button state for all size/color options.
Verify the message 'Out of Stock' appears appropriately.
test_cases.expected_result: Options are disabled, and a message indicates that the product is out of stock.

test_cases.title: Check User Reviews Submission
steps: Navigate to the user reviews section.
Click on 'Write a Review'.
Fill out the review form and submit.
test_cases.expected_result: The review is submitted successfully and appears in the reviews list.

test_cases.title: Assess Responsiveness on Mobile Device
steps: Access the product page on a mobile device.
Verify that elements stack vertically.
Ensure the 'Add to Cart' button is easily accessible at the bottom.
test_cases.expected_result: The page displays correctly with elements stacked vertically and the button is accessible.

test_cases.title: Validate Product Options Reset on Selection Change
steps: Select a size and color for a product.
Change the color option.
Verify if the size selection resets or remains unchanged.
test_cases.expected_result: Only the color changes, size remains as previously selected unless specified otherwise.

test_cases.title: Check Modal for Size Guide
steps: Access the product page.
Click on the size guide link.
Verify that a modal pops up displaying the size guide.
test_cases.expected_result: A modal displaying the size guide opens correctly when the link is clicked.

test_cases.title: Ensure Security Against Invalid Input in Review Form
steps: Navigate to the product review section.
Attempt to submit a review with invalid characters or empty fields.
Submit the form and observe the response.
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays appropriate validation messages and does not submit invalid reviews.

test_cases.title: Verify Progress Indicator Display
steps: Open the checkout summary page.
Check the presence of progress indicator.
Verify the steps are displayed in order: 'Cart -> Shipping Details -> Order Summary -> Confirmation'.
test_cases.expected_result: The progress indicator displays all steps in the correct order.

test_cases.title: Verify Product Summary is Accurate
steps: Open the checkout summary page.
Confirm that all products in the order are listed in the summary.
Verify each product's details: thumbnail, name, choices (size, color, variant), quantity, unit price, and line total.
test_cases.expected_result: All products and their details are displayed accurately in the summary.

test_cases.title: Verify Shipping Details Display
steps: Open the checkout summary page.
Locate the shipping details section.
Verify that the full shipping address is displayed clearly.
Check that the shipping method and cost are correctly listed.
test_cases.expected_result: The shipping details are displayed properly, including full address and selected shipping method.

test_cases.title: Verify Payment Details Are Partially Concealed
steps: Open the checkout summary page.
Locate the payment details section.
Confirm that only partial credit card information is displayed (e.g., **** **** **** 1234).
Check that the PayPal or Bit logo and partially concealed email/username are shown.
test_cases.expected_result: Payment details are partially concealed for security purposes.

test_cases.title: Verify Order Totals Calculation
steps: Open the checkout summary page.
Check the subtotal of products before taxes and shipping.
Verify that shipping costs, discounts, taxes, and the grand total are accurately calculated and displayed.
test_cases.expected_result: The order totals are calculated correctly and displayed with clear labeling.

test_cases.title: Verify Final Confirmation Button Behavior
steps: Open the checkout summary page.
Click the 'Confirm and Pay' button.
Ensure the button gets disabled and a spinner appears.
Check that the user cannot click the button multiple times.
test_cases.expected_result: The confirmation button is disabled, and a loading spinner is displayed after clicking.

test_cases.title: Error Handling for Payment Failure
steps: Simulate a payment failure scenario.
Attempt to make a payment.
Observe the error message displayed.
Verify that the user remains on the checkout summary page with an option to try another card or change payment method.
test_cases.expected_result: An appropriate error message is shown, and the user can retry without leaving the page.

test_cases.title: Check Sticky Total and Button on Scroll
steps: Open the checkout summary page.
Scroll down the page to ensure 'Final Price Summary' and 'Confirm and Pay' button remain visible.
test_cases.expected_result: 'Final Price Summary' and 'Confirm and Pay' button are sticky and visible at the bottom of the screen.

test_cases.title: Verify Edit Options for Item Details
steps: Open the checkout summary page.
Locate an item in the product summary.
Click on the 'Edit' link or button for the item.
Verify that the user is redirected to the cart page without losing shipping and payment details.
test_cases.expected_result: User is taken back to the cart page and retains previously filled shipping and payment information.

test_cases.title: Verify Security Assurance Message Display
steps: Open the checkout summary page.
Locate the security assurance message or icon.
Verify that it indicates data security, e.g., 'This site is secured with SSL.'
test_cases.expected_result: A security assurance message is displayed, indicating that the site is secure.

test_cases.title: Verify summary page displays all order details correctly
steps: Navigate to the checkout summary page after adding items to cart.
Verify that the order summary section displays all product details including name, quantity, price, and subtotal.
Check that the shipping details show the correct address and selected shipping method.
Confirm that the payment details are partially displayed for security.
Ensure the final price total is clearly highlighted.
test_cases.expected_result: All order details are displayed accurately and clearly in the summary.

test_cases.title: Check progress indicator functionality
steps: Add items to the cart and proceed to the checkout.
Ensure that the progress indicator shows the steps of the checkout process.
Validate that the current step is highlighted appropriately.
test_cases.expected_result: The progress indicator correctly reflects the user's current position in the checkout process.

test_cases.title: Test editing capability for product details
steps: Navigate to the summary page with product details displayed.
Click on the 'Edit' button next to a product.
Change the quantity or any other editable option.
Save the changes and verify the new values are displayed correctly in the summary.
test_cases.expected_result: Product details can be edited successfully and the summary reflects those changes accurately.

test_cases.title: Validate error message for failed payment
steps: Attempt to complete the checkout process with invalid payment details.
Wait for the payment processing to occur.
Check for the error message displayed on the summary page.
test_cases.expected_result: An appropriate error message is displayed, allowing the user to correct their payment details without exiting the summary page.

test_cases.title: Ensure security compliance indicators are displayed
steps: Open the checkout summary page.
Observe for any security compliance indicators like a lock icon or SSL message.
test_cases.expected_result: Security indicators are displayed to reassure the user regarding data protection.

test_cases.title: Check the visibility of sticky total during scrolling
steps: Navigate to the summary page with a long list of products.
Scroll down to the bottom of the page.
Observe whether the total price and confirmation button remain visible.
test_cases.expected_result: The sticky total and confirmation button stay visible during scrolling.

test_cases.title: Verify edit shipping address feature
steps: Navigate to the summary page where shipping details are displayed.
Click on the 'Edit' or 'Change' button next to the shipping address.
Modify the shipping address and save changes.
Confirm that the updated address is reflected in the summary.
test_cases.expected_result: The shipping address can be successfully edited and displays correctly in the summary.

test_cases.title: Confirm proper handling of valid coupon codes
steps: Navigate to the checkout summary page.
Apply a valid coupon code and submit.
Verify that the discount is applied to the total.
test_cases.expected_result: The coupon discount is applied successfully and reflects in the final totals.

test_cases.title: Verify behavior when the user tries to submit without agreeing to terms
steps: Navigate to the summary page.
Attempt to press the 'Confirm and Pay' button without checking the terms checkbox.
Observe the system response.
test_cases.expected_result: User cannot proceed without checking the agreement checkbox and receives a suitable message.

test_cases.title: Check the transition to order confirmation page after successful payment
steps: Complete the checkout process with valid payment details.
Observe the behavior as the payment is processed.
Confirm transition to the order confirmation page.
test_cases.expected_result: User is automatically redirected to the order confirmation page after payment is successful.
